_readme: Skill Vault v0 (Dev Guide §6 L2). Source of truth for skills and questions. Edit here, then run `npm run seed:build` to regenerate supabase/seed.sql. Each skill gets 4 questions: tools (multi), proof link, the 1-hour test (Yes / With help / No), and real-world delivery (+ link). Skills without `tools` get 3.
